image_description: A close-up, high-resolution photograph of a mature common iguana perched on a textured rock. The iguana displays characteristic features including a prominent orange-red dewlap, a serrated dorsal crest running down the neck and back, and rough, granular green-grey scales. The head is large and triangular with a visible subtympanic shield. One forelimb is clearly visible gripping the rock surface.
